scope: Bounded verification of the GDPR Article 35, 36 and 39 currentness inputs after EUR-Lex acquisition; identity comparison of the downloaded GDPR PDF and scope separation of Regulation (EU) 2025/2518.
objectives: Verify whether the downloaded EUR-Lex GDPR PDF is a new source or an exact duplicate of SRC-0010.
Record the official EUR-Lex current consolidated-version metadata used for the bounded currentness check.
Verify from validated SRC-0047 units that Regulation (EU) 2025/2518 is an additional procedural regulation and that its Articles 35 and 36 are not GDPR Articles 35 and 36.
Do not use SRC-0047 to support the wording or currentness of GDPR Articles 35, 36 or 39.

official_currentness_metadata.observed_status: In force; act has been changed; current consolidated version shown as 04/05/2016
official_currentness_metadata.use: Currentness metadata only; not a replacement for the hash-bound local text.

constraints: Read only validated Markdown units for role-level evidence.
Do not modify sources/, ingest/ or the active vault.
Do not infer that the procedural regulation amends GDPR Articles 35, 36 or 39.
Keep future amendments and corrigenda outside the conclusion unless separately evidenced.
